none: PAS CAM-6F8891: Roman Coin : A Copper-alloy Nummus Probably of Constantius II, AD337-61
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ VICTORIAE DD AVGGQ NN ; D/ (CONSTANTI-VS P. F AVG)

A copper-alloy nummus probably of Constantius II, AD337-61. Mint is Trier, AD347-348 (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads VICTORIAE DD AVGGQ NN. Reverse shows two Victories. See Ref. RIC VIII, pp.151-2, c.f.191/197. Obverse legend reads (CONSTANTI-VS P. F AVG). Obverse shows pearl-diadem, draped and cuirassed right. Mint mark is C or E*//TR[ ] . Condition is fine, die axis is probably 6…
